# terraform.wiki site block for an existing dockerized Caddy.
#
# 1) Mount the deploy path into the Caddy container (docker-compose.yml):
#
#      services:
#        caddy:
#          volumes:
#            - /srv/terraform-wiki:/srv/terraform-wiki:ro
#
# 2) Add this block to your Caddyfile, then: docker compose exec caddy caddy reload
#    (or docker compose restart caddy)
#
# 3) DNS: point an A record (and AAAA if you have IPv6) for terraform.wiki
#    at the server. Caddy provisions HTTPS automatically once DNS resolves.

terraform.wiki {
	root * /srv/terraform-wiki
	encode
	file_server

	handle_errors {
		rewrite * /404.html
		file_server
	}
}
